name: Houzuki Itsuki
source:
A boy tormented by jealousy

He is always on edge and angry about something.
Skilled in sports and studies, but is best at games.
Haunted by envy, he killed his genius brother after constant compared to him.

[Taken from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2507560/_/]Steam page[/url]]
